entity.summary: Active successor brand to IDCM. Klickl emerged from the 2022 IDCM rebrand and continues to provide crypto exchange, OTC, custody, payment and related digital-asset services through a multi-jurisdiction group structure.
entity.notes: The lineage is explicit: ADGM described Klickl in September 2022 as formerly known as IDCM, and Klickl's official company material records the IDCM brand change and domain migration. HEI uses 2022-05-13, the date of the reviewed Klickl-sourced rebrand announcement, as the successor-brand launch marker. Current 2026 first-party Klickl pages expose Quick Buy, professional trading, OTC and exchange services. The current group has operations and regulated entities across multiple jurisdictions; country_or_origin follows the historical Hong Kong origin of the IDCM/Klickl brand lineage rather than implying that every current service is Hong Kong-regulated.

events.title: Klickl received ADGM in-principle approval
events.description: Abu Dhabi Global Market announced that Klickl had received in-principle approval for a Financial Services Permission to operate as a virtual-asset broker-dealer and custody provider.
events.notes: This event records an in-principle approval, not a claim that the approval itself was a final operating licence for every Klickl product or jurisdiction.

evidence.title: KLICKL gets ADGM In-Principle approval to operate as broker-dealer and custody provider in virtual assets
evidence.notes: ADGM states that Klickl received in-principle approval and explicitly describes the group as formerly known as IDCM, independently corroborating the reviewed rebrand lineage.

evidence.title: Klickl official website
evidence.notes: Current first-party site exposes Quick Buy, professional trading, OTC and exchange services and identifies current Klickl group operating entities, supporting active status in 2026.

evidence.title: IDCM Rebranded As Klickl: What's new?
evidence.notes: Official company LinkedIn article states that IDCM officially rebranded as Klickl and changed the domain from idcm.io to klickl.com, supporting predecessor/successor identity continuity.
